source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U27: Apply the amended First Schedule and separate recognition from execution formalities

payload.title: Read the exceptions to the exclusions
payload.core_explanation_md:
The First Schedule excludes specified documents/transactions, but the 2022 amendment changes the negotiable-instrument and power-of-attorney entries and omits the immovable-property contract/conveyance entry. The described qualifying demand-promissory-note/bill route depends on the specified regulated-entity relationship; it is not every negotiable instrument. The power-of-attorney exception likewise depends on the specified regulated entity and scope. Trusts and wills remain distinct excluded categories in the source.

Removing an IT Act exclusion does not itself waive registration, stamping, attestation or other execution rules. Also distinguish DPDP staggered commencement: the RTI amendment and the IT Act amendments do not all share one start date. Pin the legal version before assessing a document intended for a particular exam session.

self_check.prompt_text: Does removal from an IT Act exclusion automatically remove registration requirements?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Other applicable formalities remain separate.

payload.stem_md: An immovable-property transaction falls outside the amended IT Act exclusion entry, and a note says registration and stamp law no longer apply. What is wrong?

options.text_md: Electronic recognition necessarily removes every other statute
options.explanation_md: Electronic recognition does not waive independently applicable registration, stamp or execution requirements.

options.text_md: The old exclusion list can never change
IT recognition and other execution/registration formalities are separate
options.explanation_md: Each applicable law still needs compliance.

options.text_md: All immovable transactions must be treated as cheques

payload.correct_explanation_md: Each applicable law still needs compliance.

payload.stem_md: A demand promissory note is assumed to qualify for the 2022 exception merely because it is electronic. Which fact must be checked?

options.text_md: The specified regulated-entity and instrument conditions

options.explanation_md: It does not establish the exception.

options.text_md: A rule that all instruments are automatically included

options.explanation_md: A display preference does not establish the specified regulated-entity and instrument conditions.
